gate_lede: Three words and a number address every ~3 m square on Earth, under a map that belongs to your seed phrase alone.
gate_phrase_placeholder: abandon ability able about above absent…
gate_generate_hint: Don't make one up. A phrase you thought of looks exactly like a random one and is enormously easier to guess.
gate_write_down_title: Write these 24 words down now, on paper.
gate_write_down_body: They are the only way back to this map, and nothing here keeps a copy. Close this tab without writing them down and every address under them is gone for good.
gate_passphrase_what: An extra secret of your own choosing — a word, a sentence, anything you like. It is not more words from the list above, and it is not a second seed phrase. Your 24 words and this together decide which map you get.
gate_passphrase_exact: You have to type it exactly the same way every time. Capital letters and spaces count. Change one character and you land on a completely different map rather than a slightly different one — that is the point of it, and also the danger. Nothing can recover it for you.
gate_passphrase_empty: Leave it empty if you are unsure. Empty is normal.
gate_deriving_hint: 2048 rounds of PBKDF2. Slow on purpose, and only once per session.
gate_wallet_warning_title: Use a fresh phrase, not a wallet seed.
gate_wallet_warning_body: Anyone who learns a few of your addresses and where they actually are is doing cryptanalysis against this key. If it also holds funds, you have combined two unrelated risks for nothing.
gate_fineprint: 24 words only. A 12-word phrase carries 128 bits of entropy, which Grover's algorithm reduces to an effective 64. Your phrase is never stored, never put in the URL, and never sent anywhere — the key is derived here, in a worker, on this device.
gate_wordlist_note: The 24 words come from the standard English BIP-39 list, in every language this app speaks.
map_label: Map. Use the arrow keys to move, plus and minus to zoom, and Enter to take the address of the centre square.
map_keyboard_hint: Arrow keys move the map, + and − zoom, Enter takes the address of the centre square.
map_zoom_for_grid: Zoom in to see the grid
map_too_many_squares: Too many squares in view to draw them all — zoom in
map_basemap_missing: No basemap found. Addressing still works over blank space; run tools/fetch-basemap.sh to download tiles.
panel_no_selection: Click any square on the map to see its address.
panel_copy_failed: Could not reach the clipboard. The address is on screen and can be selected.
panel_prefix_hint: Four-letter prefixes work, and separators are forgiving: {example} resolves the same way.
panel_footer: Addresses are meaningless to anyone with a different seed phrase. The same square has an entirely unrelated address under every other phrase.
